summary: Sezzle Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amended and Restated Loan and Receivables Sale Agreement and Marketing and Servicing Agreement with WebBank. The agreements expand the existing bank partnership program to include new products (SezzleCash and Sezzle Send), with WebBank retaining loans up to a threshold initially at $30 million, potentially increasing to $150 million. Amendments also raise Sezzle's minimum tangible net worth covenant from $12 million to $100 million and add termination events. The initial term runs through September 27, 2029. This is a routine financing/contractual arrangement, not a special situation. What to watch: future compliance with higher covenants and program expansion execution.
